isDemo().notice: True for the demo calendar, whose weekend is switched by an operator.

secondsIntoWeek(uint256).notice: Seconds since Sunday 00:00 UTC. 1 January 1970 was a Thursday, 4 days after a Sunday.

secondsUntilOpen().notice: Seconds until the market opens; 0 when it is open.

userdoc.notice: The real calendar: the T-bill market is closed from Friday 21:00 to Monday 14:00 UTC. That is 4pm to 9am New York time in winter, 65 hours, the closure the financial analysis uses. It has no owner and no settings, so nobody can change it. It does not know about holidays or daylight saving, which the project report states as limits.
